text: On 2026-11-23 the average wind output was 6797 MW, ranging from a low of 4031 MW to a high of 11507 MW, which is -14.7 % lower than the seven‑day average of 7963 MW. System demand averaged 35034 MW with a peak of 43134 MW, up 7.1 % on the previous week’s mean of 32701 MW. The average market price was £195.9/MWh, moving between £154.6/MWh and £251.2/MWh, a 5.2 % increase from the prior week’s £186.1/MWh. Day‑ahead wind forecasts showed a mean absolute error of 1025 MW, far better than the baseline error of 6199 MW. Demand forecasts posted a MAE of 1117 MW versus a baseline MAE of 1603 MW and a MAPE of 3.07 %. Data quality checks covered 29 series, with 25 passing, 2 warnings and 2 failures. Issues flagged include FAIL for wind_onshore and wind_offshore, and WARN for price_apx and price_n2ex; both wind_onshore and wind_offshore each missed 2 periods.
